name: @gobing-ai/spur
description: Spur — a local-first harness engineering toolkit that wraps mainstream coding agents with constraint checking, workflow orchestration, and history analytics.
author: Robin Min <minlongbing@gmail.com>

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && find apps packages -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && mkdir -p dist
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run --filter '@gobing-ai/spur' build && bun run --filter '@gobing-ai/spur-server' build && bun run --filter '@gobing-ai/spur-web' build
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run --filter @gobing-ai/spur build:bundle
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p plugins/sp/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.autofix: bun run format && bun run typecheck
scripts.gate: biome check . --write --error-on-warnings && bun run typecheck && bun run spur-check:tests
scripts.bundle:config: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts builder bundle-config apps/cli/config
scripts.refresh-plugin: claude plugin uninstall sp@spur -y && rm -rf ~/.claude/plugins/cache/spur && claude plugin marketplace update spur && claude plugin install sp@spur && superskill install sp --marketplace .claude-plugin
scripts.tasks: sh -c 'if [ -z "$1" ]; then echo "Usage: bun run tasks <wbs>" >&2; exit 1; fi; bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts workflow run .spur/workflows/task-pipeline.yaml --vars "{\"wbs\":\"$1\",\"profile\":\"auto\"}"' --
scripts.test-pre-check: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-pre-check --fail-on warning --no-logo
scripts.test-post-check: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule check-coverage-cert && bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-post-check --fail-on warning --no-logo
scripts.ci:digest: sh -c 'run=${1:-$(gh run list --branch "$(git branch --show-current)" --status failure --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq ".[0].databaseId")}; if [ -z "$run" ] || [ "$run" = null ]; then echo "ci:digest: no failing run on this branch (pass a run id or URL as an argument)" >&2; exit 1; fi; gh run view "$run" --json databaseId,workflowName,headSha,conclusion,url --jq "\"ci:digest: run \(.databaseId) \(.workflowName) \(.headSha[0:7]) \(.conclusion)\n\(.url)\""; hits=$(gh run view "$run" --log-failed 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\(fail\)|##\[error\]|error:|TypeError:|exited with code" | grep -vE "\(pass\)|\(skip\)" | head -40); if [ -n "$hits" ]; then printf "%s\n" "$hits"; else echo "ci:digest: no matching error lines - inspect the run log"; fi' --
scripts.test: bun run bundle:config && bun scripts/spur-dev.ts run-tests --publish-coverage test --parallel=2 --reporter=dots --timeout 20000 ./apps/cli ./apps/server ./apps/web ./packages ./plugins ./scripts
scripts.test:heavy: bun run bundle:config && bun scripts/spur-dev.ts run-tests --config=bunfig.heavy.toml test --reporter=dots .heavy.test.
scripts.test:coverage: bun run bundle:config && bun scripts/spur-dev.ts run-tests --publish-coverage test --coverage ./apps/cli ./apps/server ./apps/web ./packages ./plugins ./scripts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test:coverage && bun run test:heavy
scripts.spur-check:tests: bun run test-pre-check && bun run test && bun run test-post-check
scripts.spur-check: bun run lint && bun run spur-check:tests
scripts.spur-check-feature: bun run spur-check && bun run check-deps && bun run transition-shim-check && bun run script-contract-check && bun run workflow-promotion-check && bun run importer-schema-check && bun run test-repo-wide && bun run test:heavy
scripts.test:full: bun run bundle:config && bun scripts/spur-dev.ts run-tests --publish-coverage test ./apps/cli ./apps/server ./apps/web ./packages ./plugins ./scripts
scripts.spur-check:full: bun run check-deps && bun run transition-shim-check && bun run script-contract-check && bun run workflow-promotion-check && bun run importer-schema-check && bun run lint && bun run test-pre-check --verbose && bun run test:coverage && bun run test-post-check --verbose && bun run test:heavy
scripts.importer-schema-check: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts self migrate --no-logo && bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts self migrate --check --no-logo
scripts.load-history: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts history import && bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts history analyze
scripts.restart: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts projects stop spur-new && bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts self serve --no-open &
scripts.restart-daemon: bun build apps/cli/src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile apps/cli/spur.js --external @johnhenry/backend-webgpu && launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/ai.gobing.spur.gateway && bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts projects stop spur-new
